caption: One 1500-byte frame timed on the air: the data block lasts 1.09 ms and the second block, preamble plus ACK, DIFS and backoff, lasts 0.50 ms, giving 1.59 ms per frame and 68.6 percent efficiency.

spec.aria: A timeline of one 1500-byte frame at 11 Mbps lasting 1.59 ms, split into 1.09 ms of data transmission followed by 0.50 ms of preamble, ACK, DIFS and backoff overhead.
